title: Sodium–glucose joint encoding does not beat standard summaries in its registered renal-marker transfer test
abstract: A fixed sodium–glucose tensor-spline model failed its exploratory NHANES transfer test: weighted log-UACR MSE 0.804215 to 0.928744, delta +0.124529 (joint PSU-bootstrap95% [0.009814,1.900189]). Source-selected stronger regularization reversed the point difference (-0.003665); neither model comparison establishes a clinically useful physiological marker. Exploratory independent-cycle transfer, not untouched confirmation.
